label: sub_006_trainer_01
text: I hear you beat Grusha and earned yourself a\nGym Badge! Way to go!

label: sub_006_trainer_02
text: Now don’t you worry—you’re still free to enjoy\nthe snowy slopes here on Glaseado Mountain\r\neven now that you’ve beaten the Gym.

label: sub_006_trainer_03
text: Want to try your hand at the Snow Slope Run?

label: sub_006_trainer_04
text: Which course will you go for?

label: sub_006_trainer_05
text: The Powder Snow Course it is! Have yourself an\neasy-breezy slide down the mountain!

label: sub_006_trainer_06
text: The Blizzard Course! Copy that! Try to keep your\nfocus sharp all the way down!

label: sub_006_trainer_07
text: The Sheer Cold Course, eh? Quite a challenge,\nto be sure! Good luck out there, kid!

label: sub_006_trainer_08
text: You’ll need to ride a Pokémon down one of\nGlaseado Mountain’s natural snowy slopes...\r\nThat’s all there is to it!

label: sub_006_trainer_09
text: Choose one of three possible courses and reach\nits finish line within the target time, and you\r\nmight just earn yourself a nice prize!

label: sub_006_trainer_10
text: Have fun, give it your all, and see if you can\nkeep beating your personal bests!
